note: max_component_voxels rejects a cluster that is a face of a large surface; max_continuous_coverage_m and min_periodic_spacing_m reject structure that runs or repeats along the tunnel; max_lateral_m drops candidates further from the sensor axis than any GOST half-width (1.15-1.535 m), which is where the track-centre estimate drifts on curved recordings. This variant enables kink truncation to measure its effect on in-envelope cluster load.
